page_title: CHE 1-0 LEI | Chelsea v Leicester 09/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Josh Acheampong (Chelsea) for a tough tackle.
90+5' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) takes it short.

90+5' Tyrique George (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play. Chelsea win a corner kick.

90+3' Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
90+1' A great solo run by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the right side of the goal was easily caught by Mads Hermansen.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Here is a change. Christopher Nkunku is going off and Enzo Maresca gives the last tactical orders to Josh Acheampong (Chelsea).
89' Dangerous play by Harry Winks (Leicester). Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.

86' Great solo effort by Ricardo Pereira (Leicester) as he tricks his way through the defence before firing a low drive from just outside of the box towards the middle of the goal. Robert Sanchez is alert and denies him.
84' Substitution. Patson Daka walks off the pitch and Stephy Mavididi (Leicester) comes on as a substitute.
84' Ruud van Nistelrooy decides to make a substitution. James Justin will be replaced by Ricardo Pereira (Leicester).
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Victor Kristiansen will be replaced by Bobby De Cordova-Reid (Leicester).
82' Tosin Adarabioyo (Chelsea) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
82' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) steps up to send the ball in.

80' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Chelsea will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
78' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
78' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
77' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
77' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.
75' This shall not pass! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bilal El Khannouss trots off the pitch and is replaced by Facundo Buonanotte (Leicester).
73' Enzo Maresca has decided to substitute Cole Palmer and he is replaced by Tyrique George (Chelsea).
73' That will be all from Wesley Fofana who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea).
71' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

71' What a great touch by Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The referee blows his whistle, Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
69' Patson Daka (Leicester) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
67' James Justin (Leicester) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robert Sanchez intercepts the ball.
66' Substitution. Harry Winks (Leicester) in, Boubakary Soumare out.
65' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) sends a cross into the box, but Robert Sanchez comes off his line to gather the ball.

63' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Leicester are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.

60' 1 - 0 Nice piece of skill by Marc Cucurella (Chelsea). He perfectly collected a pass from Enzo Fernandez and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike which went into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
60' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) makes a rough challenge and Tim Robinson blows his whistle for a foul.

59' Chelsea slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
56' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Jamie Vardy (Leicester), but Robert Sanchez is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
56' Conor Coady (Leicester) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
53' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
53' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender. The referee signals a corner kick to Chelsea.
53' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.

52' Jamie Vardy (Leicester) gets inside the box and tries to beat Robert Sanchez with a measured shot into the right side of the goal, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Leicester are going to take it.
49' Chelsea take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
49' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Chelsea.
47' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) has an opportunity, but isn't able to direct the ball into the net. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
47' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.

47' What a great touch by Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Chelsea.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+7' Tim Robinson blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+4' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
45+4' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is about to take a corner kick.

45+4' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the roof of the net. Mads Hermansen is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
45+2' Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

45+2' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Leicester will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
44' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It's a throw-in for Chelsea.
41' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
39' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
37' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Tim Robinson blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
36' Leicester seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

32' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) makes a good run with the ball, but his shot from the edge of the penalty area goes just wide of the left post. Terrific solo effort, though. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
30' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
28' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) collects a rebound and produces a mid-range attempt. The ball goes to the middle of the target, but Mads Hermansen keeps it out.
27' A cross from James Justin (Leicester) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
26' Wonderful movement by Leicester. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
22' A dangerous looking corner kick from Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is cleared to safety by the defence.
22' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) doesn't take advantage of the chance to score from the penalty spot. He shoots to the bottom right corner, but Mads Hermansen leaps out to thwart his effort.
21' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
19' Victor Kristiansen (Leicester) tackles a bit over-zealously and Tim Robinson blows for a foul. Chelsea are awarded a penalty. What an opportunity to score!
19' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) sprays a pass out to Enzo Fernandez, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
16' Chelsea are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears.
13' Jadon Sancho (Chelsea) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long. The ball is out of play. Leicester will take a throw-in.
11' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.

9' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leicester.
9' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
8' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. Chelsea get a corner.

8' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. The ball goes out of play. Chelsea are awarded a corner kick.
7' Some great play by Bilal El Khannouss (Leicester) ends with a shot on the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but Robert Sanchez sees it all the way and makes a comfortable save.
4' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jadon Sancho (Chelsea), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
2' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and Leicester will have a goal kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Leicester will take the kick-off.
Tim Robinson will supervise the game today.
